text: 4.2 General Principles
trace: 4 General --> 4.2 General Principles
text_preview: 4.2 General Principles

text: For each Near-RT RIC API, the following principles should be followed:
trace: 4 General --> 4.2 General Principles
text_preview: For each Near-RT RIC API, the following principles should be followed:

text:
* A default solution that includes network protocol and message encoding should be defined to ensure interoperability. The default solution requires mandatory support by all Near-RT RIC platforms and xApps. The optional protocols available for a given APIs are discoverable by xApps.
  * The IEs in the Near-RT RIC API which refer to different specifications shall be encoded as defined in the referred specification.
trace: 4 General --> 4.2 General Principles
text_preview:
* A default solution should include network protocol and message encoding for interoperability, requiring mandatory support from all Near-RT RIC platforms and xApps. 
  * Optional protocols are discoverable by xApps, with IEs encoded according to their referenced specifications.

text: The common data types applicable to several API categories should be collected in clause 10.
trace: 4 General --> 4.2 General Principles
text_preview: The common data types applicable to several API categories should be collected in clause 10.

text: In addition, the following design principles shall apply:
trace: 4 General --> 4.2 General Principles
text_preview: In addition, the following design principles shall apply:

text: \- Parallel transactions, i.e., multiple ongoing Near-RT RIC API procedures of the same types related to the same xApp, and platform functionality are supported.

text_preview: The E2 related API procedures introduced in clause 9.3 of \[2\] are categorized under the E2 related APIs. These APIs include:

text:
* E2 Subscription API: enabling xApp to setup, modify and delete E2 subscriptions with the Near-RT RIC platform.  
  * E2 Indication API: enabling xApp to receive E2 indications associated with an E2 subscription.
  * E2 Control API: enabling xApp to consume E2 control service from the Near-RT RIC platform.
  * E2 Guidance API: enabling xApp to acquire E2 related guidance from the Near-RT RIC platform and mitigate potential conflicts with other xApps.
trace: 6 E2-related API --> 6.1.2 List of E2 related APIs, procedures and messages
text_preview:
The Near-RT RIC platform provides four APIs for xApps:

* E2 Subscription API: setup, modify, delete subscriptions.
* E2 Indication API: receive associated indications.
* E2 Control API: consume control service.
* E2 Guidance API: acquire guidance to mitigate conflicts.

text: Figure 6.2.1.1.2-1: E2 Subscription procedure, successful operation
trace: 6 E2-related API --> 6.2.1 E2\_Subscription\_API procedures --> 6.2.1.1 E2 Subscription Procedure --> 6.2.1.1.2 Successful Operation --> Figure 6.2.1.1.2-1: E2 Subscription procedure, successful operation
text_preview: Figure 6.2.1.1.2-1: E2 Subscription procedure, successful operation

text: The xApp initiates the procedure by sending an E2 SUBSCRIPTION \(Request\) message to the Near-RT-RIC platform. The message contains a unique Procedure Transaction ID IE assigned by the initiating xApp, the Global E2 Node ID IE, the RAN  Function ID IE, and the E2 Subscription Details IE including one or more requested E2 actions and optionally the E2  Subscription Timer IE. The message may include the E2 Indication Destination IE which specifies the xApp's endpoint to receive E2 indications \(see clause 6.2.2.1\), and the E2 Subscription Delete Notification Destination IE which specifies the xApp's endpoint to receive query/notification from the Near-RT RIC platform for E2 subscription deletion \(see clause 6.2.1.3/6.2.1.4\).
trace: 6 E2-related API --> 6.2.1 E2\_Subscription\_API procedures --> 6.2.1.1 E2 Subscription Procedure --> 6.2.1.1.2 Successful Operation
text_preview:
The xApp initiates a procedure by sending an E2 SUBSCRIPTION Request message to the Near-RT-RIC platform, containing:

* Unique Procedure Transaction ID IE
* Global E2 Node ID IE
* RAN Function ID IE
* E2 Subscription Details IE (with requested actions and optional timer)
* Optional E2 Indication Destination IE

text: Note: When execution order of multiple actions is not concerned, it is recommended that an E2 Subscription procedure contains a single action, to allow efficient reuse of E2 subscriptions.
trace: 6 E2-related API --> 6.2.1 E2\_Subscription\_API procedures --> 6.2.1.1 E2 Subscription Procedure --> 6.2.1.1.2 Successful Operation
text_preview: Note: When execution order of multiple actions is not concerned, it is recommended that an E2 Subscription procedure contains a single action, to allow efficient reuse of E2 subscriptions.

text: At reception of the E2 SUBSCRIPTION \(Request\) message, the Near-RT-RIC platform shall:
trace: 6 E2-related API --> 6.2.1 E2\_Subscription\_API procedures --> 6.2.1.1 E2 Subscription Procedure --> 6.2.1.1.2 Successful Operation
text_preview: At reception of the E2 SUBSCRIPTION \(Request\) message, the Near-RT-RIC platform shall:

text:
* Search existing E2 subscription\(s\) for matched Global E2 Node ID IE, RAN Function ID IE and matched contents in E2 Subscription Details IE. If a matched E2 subscription exists, add the initiating xApp as a new subscriber of the E2 subscription.  
  * Initiate appropriate E2AP procedure\(s\) to establish RIC subscription with the target E2 Node, if existing E2 subscriptions are insufficient to fulfill the request.
trace: 6 E2-related API --> 6.2.1 E2\_Subscription\_API procedures --> 6.2.1.1 E2 Subscription Procedure --> 6.2.1.1.2 Successful Operation
text_preview: Search existing E2 subscriptions for matched Global E2 Node ID and RAN Function ID. If a match exists, add the initiating xApp as a new subscriber. Initiate E2AP procedures to establish an RIC subscription if necessary.

text: The Near-RT-RIC platform may use the value in the E2 Subscription Timer IE, if present, as a one-time value of the E2AP timer TRICEVENTcreate in clause 9.5 of \[3\], which is valid only for this transaction.
trace: 6 E2-related API --> 6.2.1 E2\_Subscription\_API procedures --> 6.2.1.1 E2 Subscription Procedure --> 6.2.1.1.2 Successful Operation
text_preview: The Near-RT-RIC platform may use the value in the E2 Subscription Timer IE, if present, as a one-time value of the E2AP timer TRICEVENTcreate in clause 9.5 of \[3\], which is valid only for this transaction.

text: If the subscription request is successfully fulfilled, the Near-RT RIC platform shall send an E2 SUBSCRIPTION \(Success\) message back to the xApp. Similar to \[3\], a successfully fulfilled request shall be sent if the E2 event trigger and at least one requested E2 action are admitted.
trace: 6 E2-related API --> 6.2.1 E2\_Subscription\_API procedures --> 6.2.1.1 E2 Subscription Procedure --> 6.2.1.1.2 Successful Operation
text_preview: If the subscription request is successfully fulfilled, the Near-RT RIC platform shall send an E2 SUBSCRIPTION \(Success\) message back to the xApp. Similar to \[3\], a successfully fulfilled request shall be sent if the E2 event trigger and at least one requested E2 action are admitted.

text: In the E2 SUBSCRIPTION \(Success\) message, Near-RT RIC platform shall include the associated Procedure Transaction ID IE, Global E2 Node ID IE, RAN Function ID IE and an E2 Request ID IE assigned by the Near-RT RIC platform. The message shall also indicate the admitted E2 action\(s\) in the Actions Admitted List IE, each with the associated E2 Action ID IE assigned by the Near-RT RIC platform. The same E2 Request ID IE and E2 Action ID IE shall be present in any subsequent E2 INDICATION message\(s\). The message shall indicate, if exist, the E2 action\(s\) not admitted in the Actions Not Admitted List IE with appropriate cause\(s\).
trace: 6 E2-related API --> 6.2.1 E2\_Subscription\_API procedures --> 6.2.1.1 E2 Subscription Procedure --> 6.2.1.1.2 Successful Operation
text_preview:
In the E2 SUBSCRIPTION Success message, the Near-RT RIC platform includes:

* Procedure Transaction ID
* Global E2 Node ID
* RAN Function ID
* Assigned E2 Request ID

The message also lists admitted E2 actions with assigned IDs and indicates unadmitted actions with causes.

text: The xApp initiates the procedure by sending the E2 SUBSCRIPTION DELETE \(Request\) message to the Near-RT-RIC platform. The message contains the Global E2 Node ID IE and the E2 Request ID IE to indicate the target E2 subscription and optionally the E2 Subscription Delete Timer IE.

text: At reception of the E2 SUBSCRIPTION DELETE \(Request\) message, the Near-RT-RIC platform shall, if the delete request is accepted by the Near-RT-RIC platform:
trace: 6 E2-related API --> 6.2.1 E2\_Subscription\_API procedures --> 6.2.1.2.1 General --> 6.2.1.2.2 Successful Operation
text_preview: At reception of the E2 SUBSCRIPTION DELETE \(Request\) message, the Near-RT-RIC platform shall, if the delete request is accepted by the Near-RT-RIC platform:

text:
* Check for other subscriber\(s\) of the target E2 subscription. If such subscriber\(s\) exists, the E2 subscription shall be maintained by the Near-RT RIC platform but no longer serve the initiating xApp; if not, the E2 subscription shall be deleted.
  * Initiate appropriate E2AP procedure\(s\) with the target E2 Node, if necessary, to map the change in the target E2 subscription to its corresponding RIC subscription.
trace: 6 E2-related API --> 6.2.1 E2\_Subscription\_API procedures --> 6.2.1.2.1 General --> 6.2.1.2.2 Successful Operation

* Check for other subscribers of the target E2 subscription. If found, maintain it by Near-RT RIC platform but no longer serve the initiating xApp; otherwise, delete it.
* Initiate necessary E2AP procedures with the target E2 Node to map changes in the target E2 subscription to its corresponding RIC subscription.

text: The Near-RT-RIC platform may use the value in the E2 Subscription Delete Timer IE, if present, as a one-time value of the E2AP timer TRICEVENTdelete in clause 9.5 of \[3\], which is valid only for this transaction.

text: Upon success of the above processing for the target E2 subscription, the Near-RT RIC platform shall stop delivering its associated E2 INDICATION message\(s\) to the initiating xApp and respond the xApp with an E2 SUBSCRIPTION DELETE\(Success\) message. The E2 SUBSCRIPTION DELETE \(Success\) message shall include the same Global E2 Node ID IE and E2 Request ID IE from the request message.

text: The Near-RT RIC platform may consult each concerned xApp before deciding to delete an E2 subscription. The Near-RT RIC platform initiates the procedure by sending an E2 SUBSCRIPTION DELETE Query \(Required\) message to the xApp. The message contains the Global E2 Node ID IE and the E2 Request ID IE to identify the target E2 subscription.
trace: 6 E2-related API --> 6.2.1 E2\_Subscription\_API procedures --> 6.2.1.3.2 Successful Operations
text_preview: The Near-RT RIC platform may consult each concerned xApp before deleting an E2 subscription. It initiates the procedure by sending an E2 SUBSCRIPTION DELETE Query message, containing Global E2 Node ID and E2 Request ID IEs to identify the target subscription.

text: At reception of the E2 SUBSCRIPTION DELETE Query \(Required\) message, the xApp shall respond by an E2 SUBSCRIPTION DELETE Query \(Accept\) message, if the xApp agrees to delete the E2 subscription based on its own evaluation. The reply message shall contain the same Global E2 Node ID IE, E2 Request ID IE, and RAN Function ID IE as in the corresponding E2 SUBSCRIPTION DELETE \(Required\) message. The Near-RT RIC platform should consider the suggestions from all concerned xApps, but the decision for the E2 subscription is up to the Near-RT RIC platform.
trace: 6 E2-related API --> 6.2.1 E2\_Subscription\_API procedures --> 6.2.1.3.2 Successful Operations
text_preview: When receiving an E2 SUBSCRIPTION DELETE Query Required message, the xApp responds with an E2 SUBSCRIPTION DELETE Query Accept message if it agrees to delete the E2 subscription. text: The xApp initiates the procedure by sending the E2 CONTROL \(Request\) message to the Near-RT-RIC platform, containing the Global E2 Node ID IE, the RAN Function ID IE, optionally the E2 Call Process ID IE, E2 Control Header IE, E2 Control  Message IE, optionally the E2 Control Ack Request IE and optionally the E2 Control Timer IE.

text: At reception of the E2 CONTROL \(Request\) message, the Near-RT-RIC platform shall:
trace: 6 E2-related API --> 6.2.3 E2\_Control\_API procedures --> 6.2.3.1.2 Successful Operation
text_preview: At reception of the E2 CONTROL \(Request\) message, the Near-RT-RIC platform shall:

text:
* Evaluate whether to reject the request due to potential control conflict, when such evaluation is required by conflict mitigation related configuration.
  * Initiate appropriate E2AP RIC Control procedure with the target E2 Node, if the request is not rejected by the Near-RT-RIC platform.
trace: 6 E2-related API --> 6.2.3 E2\_Control\_API procedures --> 6.2.3.1.2 Successful Operation
text_preview:
* Evaluate whether to reject the request due to potential control conflict, when such evaluation is required by conflict mitigation related configuration.
  * Initiate appropriate E2AP RIC Control procedure with the target E2 Node, if the request is not rejected by the Near-RT-RIC platform.

text: The Near-RT-RIC platform may use the value in the E2 Control Timer IE, if present, as a one-time value of the E2AP timer TRICcontrol in Clause 9.5 of \[3\], which is valid only for this transaction.

text_preview: The Near-RT-RIC platform may use the value in the E2 Control Timer IE, if present, as a one-time value of the E2AP timer TRICcontrol in Clause 9.5 of \[3\], which is valid only for this transaction.

text: If the control request is successfully performed, and if the optional E2 Control Ack Request IE in the request is absent or set to "Ack", an E2 CONTROL \(Success\) message shall be responded to the initiating xApp. The E2 CONTROL \(Success\) message shall include the Global E2 Node ID IE, the RAN Function ID IE, optionally the E2 Call Process ID IE, and optionally the E2  Control Outcome IE. The xApp may use the information contained in the optional E2 Control Outcome IE to determine subsequent actions.
trace: 6 E2-related API --> 6.2.3 E2\_Control\_API procedures --> 6.2.3.1.2 Successful Operation
text_preview: If a control request is successfully performed and the optional E2 Control Ack Request IE is absent or set to "Ack", respond with an E2 CONTROL Success message, including Global E2 Node ID IE, RAN Function ID IE, and optionally E2 Call Process ID IE and E2 Control Outcome IE.

text: If the control request is successfully performed, and if the optional E2 Control Ack Request IE in the request is set to "NoAck", an E2 CONTROL \(Success\) message is not needed and xApp may consider it success.

text_preview:

text:
E2 Node State| Meaning  
---|---  
CONNECTED| E2 Node has completed E2 Setup procedure.  
| Near-RT RIC platform has at least one validated E2NodeComponentConfig and  
| E2NodeRanFunction record available for xApps using SDL API.  
| xApp may use E2 related API to request E2 Subscription and E2 Control  
| procedures  
RESET| E2 connection to E2 Node has been reset using E2AP Reset procedure.  
| Near-RT RIC platform has at least one validated E2NodeComponentConfig and  
| E2NodeRanFunction record available for xApps using SDL API.  
| Previous E2 Subscriptions have been deleted  
| E2 related API services not available  
DISCONNECTED| E2 connection to E2 Node is not available  
| xApp shall delete records for E2 Node
trace: 7.3 Elements for SDL API Communication --> 7.3.3 Information Element Definitions --> 7.3.3.28 SDL Data Type specific IE Definitions --> 7.3.3.28.1.13 E2 Node State
text_preview:
E2 Node State| Meaning
---|---
CONNECTED | E2 Node completed setup, validated config, and ran function record available.
RESET | Reset procedure deleted previous subscriptions, but no new ones are available.
DISCONNECTED | Connection is not available; xApp should delete records for E2 Node.

text: Figure 8.2.1.2-1: xApp Registration procedure, successful operation
trace: 8.2 Management API Procedures --> 8.2.1 xApp Registration Procedure --> 8.2.1.2 Successful Operation

text: The xApp initiates the procedure by sending an xApp Registration \(Request\) message to the Near-RT-RIC platform. The message contains a unique Procedure Transaction ID IE assigned by the initiating xApp, the optional xApp Description IE, and the Required APIs and Data Types IE that specifies the APIs and data types needed for normal operation of the xApp.
trace: 8.2 Management API Procedures --> 8.2.1 xApp Registration Procedure --> 8.2.1.2 Successful Operation
text_preview: The xApp initiates the procedure by sending an xApp Registration Request message to the Near-RT-RIC platform. The message contains a unique Procedure Transaction ID, optional xApp Description IE, and Required APIs and Data Types IE specifying needed APIs and data types for normal operation of the xApp.

text: At reception of the xApp Registration \(Request\) message, the Near-RT-RIC platform shall:
trace: 8.2 Management API Procedures --> 8.2.1 xApp Registration Procedure --> 8.2.1.2 Successful Operation
text_preview: At reception of the xApp Registration \(Request\) message, the Near-RT-RIC platform shall:

text:
* Check xApp's compatibility with the Near-RT RIC platform, using information in the Required APIs and Data Types IE.  
  * Assign an xApp ID and create the profile for the xApp.
trace: 8.2 Management API Procedures --> 8.2.1 xApp Registration Procedure --> 8.2.1.2 Successful Operation
text_preview:
* Check xApp's compatibility with the Near-RT RIC platform, using information in the Required APIs and Data Types IE.  
  * Assign an xApp ID and create the profile for the xApp.

text: If the registration request is successfully fulfilled, the Near-RT RIC platform shall send an xApp Registration \(Success\) message back to the xApp.
trace: 8.2 Management API Procedures --> 8.2.1 xApp Registration Procedure --> 8.2.1.2 Successful Operation
text_preview: If the registration request is successfully fulfilled, the Near-RT RIC platform shall send an xApp Registration \(Success\) message back to the xApp.

text: In the xApp Registration \(Success\) message, the Near-RT RIC platform shall include the associated Procedure Transaction ID IE and the xApp ID IE.

trace: 10.1 Information element definitions --> 10.1.1 PTI

text: The Procedure Transaction Identity \(PTI\) IE allows identifing a procedure among all ongoing parallel procedures of the same type initiated by the same RICAPI peer. The PTI value is assigned to the initiating message by the procedure initiator, and subsequent messages shall include the same PTI value as in the initiating message, if any. PTI is released when the procedure is completed.
